By utilizing multi-agent co-evolution and structured discrepancy-driven evaluation, agents can autonomously explore complex problem spaces, refine algorithms, and adapt to changing environments without external instruction. Summary: Autonomous agents can successfully formulate and investigate new scientific problems by combining curiosity-driven exploration with collaborative multi-agent execution and rigorous validation.
